questions.question: Find the production code and channel of the most recently aired cartoon .
questions.gold_sql: select production_code ,  channel from cartoon order by original_air_date desc limit 1
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.Production_code, c.Channel
FROM Cartoon AS c
ORDER BY
  CAST(substr(c.Original_air_date, instr(c.Original_air_date, ',') + 1) AS INTEGER) DESC,
  CASE
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'January%' THEN 1
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'February%' THEN 2
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'November%' THEN 11
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'December%' THEN 12
  END DESC,
  CASE
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'January%' THEN CAST(substr(c.Original_air_date, 8, instr(c.Original_air_date, ',') - 8) AS INTEGER)
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'February%' THEN CAST(substr(c.Original_air_date, 9, instr(c.Original_air_date, ',') - 9) AS INTEGER)
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'November%' THEN CAST(substr(c.Original_air_date, 9, instr(c.Original_air_date, ',') - 9) AS INTEGER)
    WHEN c.Original_air_date LIKE 'December%' THEN CAST(substr(c.Original_air_date, 9, instr(c.Original_air_date, ',') - 9) AS INTEGER)
  END DESC
LIMIT 1;

ambiguity.reason: The question specifies the Cartoon record with the latest Original_air_date and requests its Production_code and Channel.
